name: ge-tax-overview
description: Tax overview for Georgia (the country, GE) for tax year 2026: one page on how the system works under the Tax Code of Georgia and who runs it (the Revenue Service, rs.ge). Covers the tax year and the national and local taxes; the Georgian lari; residence for individuals (183 days in any 12 months) and companies (place of business or management); the flat 20% personal income tax and the exemption for income that is not from a Georgian source; the 1% small business and 0% micro business regimes; profit tax at 15% only on distributed profit, with the 0.85 gross-up; dividends and interest withheld at 5%; VAT at 18% with a GEL 100,000 registration threshold and monthly returns; property tax up to 1% for companies; and the main deadlines (monthly returns by the 15th, annual returns before 1 April). Trigger phrases: Georgia tax system, taxes in Georgia country, Georgia tax overview, rs.ge, Revenue Service Georgia. Out of scope: the detail in the domain skills linked below.
